_readme: First-open Firestore document reads per page and role in the E2E every-page smoke (tests/e2e/tabs-smoke.spec.js), counted by the app's read meter (www/js/firebase/firestore-meter.js). 'startup' = login until the app is ready. A page fails when it reads more than its baseline + tolerance (25%; at least minSlack reads, so one late listener update on a page that reads 0-4 documents is not a failure) or more than hardCap. Each value is the highest count seen across en/hi, phone/desktop and the CI shards. Update: if a change makes a page read more on purpose, run `E2E_RECORD_READS=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/tabs-smoke.spec.js` (raises baselines, never lowers them; to lower one, delete its entry first and re-record), check the diff and say why in the PR.
